PLAN "Strong Through Pregnancy: 12-Week Moderate Strength Plan"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength and movement capacity through pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Tolerance" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          box squat (to parallel) 4x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          trap bar deadlift 4x5..6 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          split squat (front foot elevated) 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable pull-through 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          standing calf raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Push/Pull A":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          standing overhead press (dumbbells) 4x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          1-arm cable row (standing) 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline dumbbell press (30 degrees) 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat pulldown (neutral grip) 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          half-kneeling landmine press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower Body Strength B":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          front squat (to box) 4x5..6 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          romanian deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          step-up (medium box) 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
